name: claude
tagline_zh: 别人家 Agent 只会聊天，这包技能让 Claude 直接上手干活。写代码、改文件、跑命令，一次配齐。
tagline_en: Stop chatting, start doing. This skill pack turns Claude into a hands-on coder—write, edit, run, all in one place.
why_zh: 同类散装教程要自己拼，这包直接给齐可用的技能集合，装完就能跑，省掉半天配置时间。
why_en: Unlike scattered tutorials, this is a ready-to-use skill collection—install once, run immediately, no assembly required.
